name: Illustrated Traces of the Sage Confucius, adapted from Sima Qian by Zhang Kai, expanded by He Xun, and reproduced by Zhu Jianjun in 1497
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；c. 1506；Accordion-fold woodblock-printed book; ink on paper; with a printed postface dated to 1497.  Circa 1506 reprint of the Jifu edition, which was first published in 1497.
